name: After § 20
title: REPORT European political parties and foundations – 2026 report on the application of Regulation (EU, Euratom) No 2025/2445 and on the activities funded
part_text: 20b. Calls on the Commission to present a comparative assessment of the transparency, reporting and audit obligations applicable to European political foundations and to other EU-funded entities, including non-governmental organisations, and to propose measures ensuring consistent, proportionate and transparent standards across EU funding programmes;
